versions.content: EcucUriReferenceDef properties With the EcucUriRef- erenceDef it is possible to define one reference where the destination is specified via a destinationUri . Any EcucContainerDef with an identical destinationUri defines a valid reference target. The destination of an EcucUriReferenceDef may be a EcucParamConfContainerDef or a EcucChoiceContainerDef .
